subject: pathology
title: Alcoholic Hepatitis, Mallory-Denk Bodies, NAFLD, and NASH

steps.tx: Alcoholic hepatitis inflames a steatotic liver acutely with jaundice, fever, and tender hepatomegaly after heavy drinking, Maddrey and MELD scores grading whether steroids help or harm. A Maddrey discriminant function of 32 or above, or MELD beyond about 20, marks severe disease where prednisolone enters discussion, and the day seven **Lille score** then splits responders who continue from nonresponders whose steroids stop before infection cashes in.
steps.say: Jaundice within weeks of heavy drinking plus high Maddrey score frames the alcoholic hepatitis steroid question.

left.title: Steroids considered
points: Lille response at day seven decides

steps.tx: Mallory-Denk bodies rope damaged intermediate filaments into eosinophilic hyaline tangles inside ballooned hepatocytes, shared by alcoholic and metabolic steatohepatitis and cholestatic injury alike. Ubiquitin and p62 accumulate inside each **Mallory-Denk body** because proteasomal disposal has failed, and cytokeratin 8 and 18 loss leaves the hepatocyte swollen and pale; identical ropes appear in Wilson disease and chronic cholestasis, never proving alcohol by themselves.
steps.say: Mallory-Denk bodies are filament wreckage in ballooned hepatocytes, not specific to alcohol alone.

steps.tx: Neutrophils satelliting Mallory containing hepatocytes, chicken wire perivenular fibrosis, and steatosis compose alcoholic steatohepatitis histology before cirrhosis seals it. Perivenular collagen laid in a delicate chicken wire mesh around central veins marks zone 3 injury first, and **satellitosis**, neutrophils hugging a dying ballooned hepatocyte, leans alcoholic over metabolic when the drinking history corroborates what the slide suggests.
steps.say: Satellitosis around Mallory hepatocytes with chicken wire fibrosis is steatohepatitis under glass.

steps.tx: On this slide the injured hepatocytes swell pale and ballooned, their cytoplasm tangled with the ropey pink clumps pathologists call **Mallory-Denk bodies**. Neutrophils crowd against those dying cells in satellitosis, a pairing that leans alcoholic rather than metabolic when the history fits. Fat still fills neighbouring hepatocytes, reminding you that steatosis came first and hepatitis arrived second. Together these features let the microscope support alcoholic steatohepatitis even before the drinking history is fully believed.
steps.say: Ballooned hepatocytes, Mallory-Denk bodies and neutrophil satellitosis together build the histology of alcoholic steatohepatitis.

steps.tx: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, now metabolic dysfunction associated steatotic liver disease, fills hepatocytes with fat in obesity and diabetes, mostly indolent steatosis, minority inflaming into NASH. The newer name demands at least one cardiometabolic risk factor beside steatosis, and fat occupying over five percent of hepatocytes defines the entry point; only about a fifth of those patients develop **steatohepatitis**, the inflamed form carrying fibrotic momentum.
steps.say: Fat plus metabolic risk defines the modern name; only the inflamed minority march toward cirrhosis.

vis.caption: Cirrhosis endpoint shared by alcoholic and metabolic steatohepatitis roads.

steps.tx: NASH adds ballooning and lobular inflammation to steatosis with perivenular fibrosis staging its prognosis, cardiovascular disease outkilling liver disease in early stages. Fibrosis stage outpredicts every enzyme value, so a FIB-4 built from age, transaminases and platelet count triages who needs elastography; stage 3 bridging or stage 4 **cirrhosis** converts routine metabolic follow up into variceal screening and six monthly cancer surveillance.
steps.say: Stage the fibrosis, treat the heart risk; early NASH patients die cardiovascularly more than hepatically.

steps.tx: Seven to ten percent body weight loss resolves steatohepatitis in most adherent patients, exercise helping independently, while bariatric surgery and metabolic drugs serve selected advanced cases. Benefit climbs in steps: five percent trims steatosis, seven percent cools inflammation, and ten percent can regress fibrosis by a stage, so the prescription names a **weight loss** target with the same precision expected of any drug dose written on the chart.
steps.say: Ten percent weight loss is NASH's most proven drug; prescribe it with the seriousness of one.

steps.tx: Alcohol abstinence after alcoholic hepatitis decides survival more powerfully than any drug, addiction services therefore joining hepatology from admission rather than discharge leaflets. Returning to drinking after discharge predicts death more strongly than the admission severity score, so baclofen or acamprosate, thiamine cover and a booked addiction review before discharge form part of **abstinence** care rather than optional lifestyle advice appended at the door.
steps.say: Abstinence is the only survival drug proven in alcoholic hepatitis; addiction care starts on day one.

steps.tx: Steatosis alone on imaging with normal enzymes still earns fibrosis risk scoring because silent advanced fibrosis hides in diabetes clinics, not liver units. A **FIB-4** under 1.3 makes advanced fibrosis unlikely enough for primary care monitoring, scores between 1.3 and 2.67 earn elastography, and anything above that band travels to hepatology even when the patient feels entirely well and enzymes sit stubbornly normal.
steps.say: Normal enzymes never acquit fibrosis in diabetes; score or scan every steatotic liver's stiffness.
